description: Single source of truth for the site motion language. Generated into lib/motion-tokens.ts (TypeScript), components/motion/motion-tokens.css (CSS custom properties), and scripts/motion/motion_theme.py (offline clip theme). Edit this file, then run npm run generate:motion-tokens. The binding design input is docs/design/motion-language.md.

state.means: estimate, belief, position, the main object

highlight.means: Indicate, selection, the thing to look at now
highlight.lightGraphicTreatment: lime halo or underlay behind the one highlighted mark
highlight.encoding: dark-green note and leader line; a lime halo marks at most one point, never a control fill

smooth.note: The single eased-motion curve for every beat; simulation time runs linearly in model time and is never eased.

stageScale.note: Painted CSS pixels at any stage at least fullSizeMinStagePx wide (the stage of the 375 px article layout). Every stage role paints at 14 px, the smallest size a reader with no engineering background reads at a glance; roles differ by weight and colour, not size. Readouts use the brand sans with tabular figures; the mono face is for code only. A narrower stage shrinks the whole figure, text included, so its layout still fits.
